user.title: Trybatec account
user.description: Enter the credentials for the Trybatec portal and the UUID from your portal's /indexes/ page URL. This is an unofficial integration.

data.deal_id: Deal ID (UUID from the Indexes page URL)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve data from Trybatec.
error.invalid_deal_id: The deal ID must be a UUID.

abort.already_configured: This Trybatec account and deal are already configured.

settings.title: Trybatec options
settings.description: Tariff JSON example: {"2025": {"EF": {"rate": 4.25, "status": "provisional"}}. Supported fluids: EF, ECS, CET. Costs are estimates, not a billing statement.

history_review.title: Choose a reading for review
history_review.description: Run trybatec.preview_history first. Only readings from the latest preview appear.

history_decision.title: Reading decision
history_decision.description: Original Trybatec reading remains unchanged. Decision is stored locally.

history_correction.title: Correct or attribute a reading
history_correction.description: Only correct measurement date with evidence. Accounting attribution is a convention, not a measurement timestamp.

history_confirm.title: Confirm reading decision

error.invalid_tariffs: Invalid tariff JSON. See the example.
error.invalid_review_correction: Invalid or ambiguous date/time (daylight saving change).

abort.history_preview_required: First run a new history preview from Developer Tools → Actions.
